rows.title_short: Contra State Of The Nation Address ( S O N A )
rows.abstract: Reaffirmed support and cooperation for the Administrations's agenda for sustainable development and programs to alleviate poverty, protect the marginalized and strengthen the economy.  Stated that the SONA, instead of being a blueprint for development and policy direction, it was a complaint sheet and continuation of campaign rhetoric.  Made some clarifications on issues like administrative infractions, huge budget deficit, the calamity fund released to a district in Pampanga and excessive rice importation, among others.  Pointed out that the President's SONA can also be assessed or judged by what if failed to say on several matters which he had enumerated.  Noted that there is much to be desired  in the President's actualization of his proposed legislative agenda as represented be his announced priority bills such as the Fiscal Responsibility Bill; the Procumerement Law; the Anti-Trust Law, and the National Defense Act to cite a few.  Appreciated the proffered adoption and continuation of the previous administration programs such as:  public-private partnerships on capital expenditure projects, conditional cash transfer, national household index project, and universal coverage under the PhilHealth social insurance.  Said that the Minority criticizes the SONA as a way of telling the President to validate the information given to him by his subalterns and to use it as an instrument to advocate reform and development, and not as a weapon to vilify and destroy.
rows.status: Pending First Reading (Filed last 2010-07-27)
rows.remarks: Interpellations by Reps. Golez, Marcoleta and Gunigundo.  Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.author: G063
rows.title_full: PUSHING SARANGANI
rows.title_short: State Of The Province Of Sarangani And Legislative Agenda
rows.abstract: Emphasized the tremendous poverty in his province wherein 40% of the people have no adequate housing, food and proper nutrition.  He stressed that he intends to do the following:  diversify the production, post-harvest and marketing processes of corn, rice and coconut; improve the livelihood, health and education of the people; pursue Sarangani's access to the rest of the country by building RORO ports and putting up satellite government offices at strategic places; adhere to the principles of transparent and accountable governance; implement a reforestation plan; and bring back the clear blue waters and plentiful marine life along the Sarangani coastline.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on MINDANAO AFFAIRS since 2010-08-10
rows.remarks: Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.author: G033
rows.title_short: Power Crisis In Mindanao
rows.abstract: TALKED ABOUT THE POWER CRISIS IN MINDANAO AND THE NEED FOR GOVERNMENT TO ACTIVELY SEARCH FOR ALTERNATIVE SOURCES OF ENERGY.  DISCUSSED THE IMPORTANT ROLE OF ELECTRICITY CONSUMPTION TO ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND NOTED THE INEQUITABLE DISTRIBUTION AND PRICING OF POWER IN NORTHERN MINDANAO WHICH COULD SLOW DOWN ITS DEVELOPMENT.  URGED THE HOUSE TO INITIATE PRO-POOR AND PRODUCTIVITY-ORIENTED LEGISLATIONS, SUCH AS THE REVISION OF THE ELECTRIC POWER INDUSTRY REFORM ACT (EPIRA)
rows.status: Pending First Reading (Filed last 2010-07-28)
rows.remarks: Interpellations by Bag-ao, Ungab, Banal, Tinio and Benaldo.  Referred to the Committee on Energy.

rows.author: G034
rows.title_full: PEACE AND ORDER SITUATION IN MINDANAO
rows.title_short: M I L F Attacks In Lanao Del Norte
rows.abstract: TOOK THE FLOOR AS A MOTHER WHO HAS EXPERIENCED THE PAINS AND SUFFERINGS OF HER CHILDREN WHEN ON SEVERAL OCCASIONS, VIOLENT ATTACKS AND DEATHS ENGULFED HERE PROVINCE.  RELATED INCIDENTS WHEREIN THE PHIL. ARMY AND THE MILF CLASHED AND RESULTED IN THE BURNING OF PROPERTIES SUCH THAT THE MUSLIMS ENDED UP SYMPATHIZING WITH THE LATTER.  DISCLOSED HOW IN APRIL 2003, CERTAIN HUNGER-STRICKEN FAMILIES IN EIGHT MUNICIPALITIES WERE EVACUATED AND TRAUMATIZED BY THE MILITARY'S PUNITIVE ACTIONS AGAINST THE MILF, AND HOW IN AUGUST 2008, THE MILF LOOTED CERTAIN TOWNS AND KILLED INNOCENT CIVILIANS.  APPEALED TO CONSIDER HER RECOMMENDATIONS OF NEGOTIATING PEACE WITH THE MILF TO PROTECT THE CIVILIANS, BY HAVING FIGHTING BATTALIONS FROM THE ARMY TO SECURE THE PROVINCE, PROVIDING GOOD ROADS TO FACILITATE MILITARY MOVEMENT AND ALLOWING QUALITY EDUCATION AS WELL AS LIVELIHOOD ASSISTANCE.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SAFETY since 2010-08-10
rows.remarks: Manifestation by Rep. Biazon.  Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.author: A007
rows.title_short: Power Situation In Leyte And Review Of E P I R A Law
rows.abstract: EXPRESSED CONCERN THAT ALL THE GEOTHERMAL FIELDS AND PLANTS IN THE VISAYAS HAD BEEN SOLD TO ONE GROUP THAT FORMS ONE OF THE NEW OLIGOPOLY IN THE POWER INDUSTRY AND THAT ONLY THE ELECTRICITY PRODUCED FROM THE ENERGY DEVELOPMENT CORP. PLANTS ARE NOW CONTRACTED TO THE STATE-OWNED NATIONAL POWER CORPORATION.  SAID THAT THIS WILL ALSO BE PRIVATIZED AND SOLD BY THE PSALM) ON JULY 30, 2010.  OPINED THAT CONTROL OF NO LESS THAN 50% OF THE DEPENDABLE CAPACITY IN THE VISAYAS WILL MAKE MARKET PRONE TO MARKET ABUSE OR EXERCISE OF MARKET POWER WHICH IS PROHIBITED AND DISCOURGAED UNDER THE EPIRA.  POINTED OUT THAT IN OPTIMIZING THE CONTRACTS FOR THE COUNTRY'S POWER ASSETS, GOV'T SHOULD ALSO CONSIDER IN THE FORTHCOMING IPP PRIVATIZATION CONTRACTS, THAT THE CONSUMERS, WHO HAVE ALREADY PAID FOR THE COST OF THE IPPs IN THE EARLIER POWER PURCHASE ADJUSTMENTS, SHOULD NOT BE MADE TO PAY ANEW FOR THE GENERATION COSTS RECOVERIES.  CLAIMED THAT REVENUES FROM THE PRIVATIZATION OF IPPS HAVE NOT YET BEEN ABLE TO COMPLETELY PAY FOR THE STRANDED DEBTS, THE GOVERNMENT NOW HAS THE TIME TO \"REORIENT THE PRIVATIZATION PROCESS\".  CONTENDED THAT THE \"CRITERION OF OPTIMIZATION\" IS NOT ONLY FINANCIAL GAIN BUT EFFECTIVENESS AND FUNCTIONALITY; THUS, THE OBJECTIVE MAY BE THE MAXIMIZATION OF FINANCIAL PROCEEDS, SUBJECT TO THE PROTECTION OF PUBLIC INTEREST THROUGH AFFORDABLE AND REASONABLE RATES.  ADVERTED TO THE POWER SHORTAGES AND COSTLY ELECTRICITY RATES IN HIS PROVINCE.  ARGUED FOR THE RIGHTS OF HOST PROVINCES OF GEOTHERMAL POWER GENERATING FACILITIES FOR \"EQUITABLE PREFERENTIAL TREATMENT\".  NOTED THAT THE ENFORCED POWER SHORTAGES IN THE HOST PROVINCES NOT ONLY AMOUNT TO DISCRIMINATION AGAINST THEIR RESIDENTS BUT ALSO A CONTRAVENTION OF SEC.2(e) OF THE EPIRA WHICH PROVIDES \"FAIR AND NONDISCRIMINATORY TREATMENT OF PUBLIC AND PRIVATE SECTOR ENTITIES IN THE PROCESS OF RESTRUCTURING THE ELECTRIC POWER INDUSTRY\".  SOUGHT FOR A CONGRESSIONAL INQUIRY, CITING THAT THIS WOULD BE PREJUDICIAL TO THE PROVINCE OF LEYTE BECAUSE OF ELECTRIC POWER SHORTAGES AND HIGH ELECTRICITY RATES AND EQUALLY IMPORTANT, INVESTMENTS TO THE PROVINCE.
rows.status: Pending First Reading (Filed last 2010-07-28)
rows.remarks: Interpellations by Rep. Magsaysay (M.), Fua,  Fuentebella and Evardone.  Referred to the Committee on Energy.

rows.author: F102
rows.title_short: New Economies For A New Administration
rows.abstract: FOCUSED ON THE PERVASIVE CORRUPTION AND THE SUBVERSION OF THE COUNTRY'S DEMOCRATIC INSTITUTIONS BY THE PREVIOUS ADMINISTRATION AND PROPOSED A PARADIGM SHIFT IN THE GOVERNMENT'S POLICY TO COMPLEMENT ITS FIGHT AGAINST CORRUPTION AMD TO OVERTURN THE PREJUDICIAL ECONOMIC POLICIES AND PROGRAMS OF THE PAST LEADERSHIP.  DELVED INTO SOME OF THE DETAILS OF SUCH CORRUPTION AND ENUMERATED THE PROMINENT ONES.  CLAIMED THAT FOR ALL THESE MISDEEDS AND ACTS OF CORRUPTION, FORMER PRES. GLORIA MACAPAGAL-ARROYO DESERVES PROSECUTION.  ENUMERATED CERTAIN FLAWS IN THE COUNTRY'S ECONOMIC POLICIES THAT NEED TO BE ADDRESSED BY THE AQUINO ADMINISTRATION WHICH HAD RESULTED TO A MINIMAL GROSS DOMESTIC PRODUCT (GDP) GROWTH RATE, THE DECIMATION OF THE MANUFACTURING SECTOR AND AN INCREASED POVERTY  RATE.  PROPOSED THAT GOVERNMENT UNDERTAKE PROACTIVE DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMS TO PUT AN END TO SEEMINGLY UNENDING CRISIS IN THE LOCAL ECONOMY.  SPOKE ON THE FOLLOWING MATTERS:  AGRICULTURE, HACIENDA LUISITA, PURCHASING POWER OF LOWER INCOME GROUPS, ACTIVATING A VIBRANT DOMESTIC MARKET, VALUE OF WOMEN'S WORK, ECONOMIC WELFARE OF INDIGENOUS PEOPLES, MINING POLICY, ORGANIC AGRICULTURAL METHODS SUITABLE TO SMALL-SCALE FARMING, WATER AND POWER RATES INCREASE AND TAXATION.
rows.status: Pending First Reading (Filed last 2010-08-02)
rows.remarks: Interpellation by Rep. Fua.

rows.author: G068
rows.title_short: Role Of Truth Commission
rows.abstract: EXPRESSED HIS STAND AGAINST THE CREATION OF THE TRUTH COMMISSION.  SAID THAT THE PRESIDENT MUST EPITOMIZE A KIND OF GOVERNANCE EMBEDDED ON THE VIRTUES OF RECONCILIATION AND NOT RETRIBUTION, OF COMPASSION AND NOT CONDEMNATION, OF DEFERENCE AND NOT DEFAMATION, AND OF APPRECIATION AND NOT PERSECUTION.  UNDERSCORED THAT THE PRESIDENT MUST ALSO UNCOVER THE MISDEEDS OF THE FORMER PRESIDENTS AND NOT JUST FOCUS ON ARROYO ADMIN.  STATED THAT THE NEW ADMINISTRATION SHOULD EMBARK ON A GENUINE HEALING PROCESS WITH FIRMER RESOLVE AND RENEWED RESILIENCY, AND MOVE FORWARD BY SEEKING NOT JUST THE TRUTH BUT THE WISDOM TO DO GOOD AND THE WILL TO REJECT EVIL.
rows.status: Pending First Reading (Filed last 2010-08-03)
rows.remarks: Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.author: E022
rows.title_full: ROLE OF THE PARTY LIST MEMBERS IN THE HOUSE
rows.title_short: Partylist Representatives
rows.abstract: SAID THAT THE MEMBERS BELONGING TO PROGRESSIVE PARTY-LIST BLOC WHO VOTED FOR SPEAKER BELMONTE, JR. ARE NOW BEING ASKED WHETHER THEY WOULD NO LONGER BE CRITICAL OF THE LEGISLATIVE AGENDA OF THE LEADERSHIP AS THEY ARE NOW PART OF THE MAJORITY.  CLARIFIED THE ROLE OF PARTY-LIST REPRESENTATIVES BY QUOTING THE SUPREME COURT DECISION IN THE CASE OF BAYAN MUNA AND OFW PARTY VS. THE SOLICITOR GENERAL - TO REPRESENT THE CONCERNS OF THEIR CONSTITUENCIES AND GIVE THEM A DIRECT VOICE IN CONGRESS.  EXPRESSED SKEPTICISM ON WHETHER THE NEW ADMINISTRATION WOULD BE ABLE TO DELIVER THE CHANGE CONSIDERING THE LACK OF ANY PRONOUNCEMENTS ON ANY POLICY CHANGE OR PROPOSAL THAT WOULD ADDRESS THE ROOT PROBLEMS OF THE COUNTRY.  LIKEWISE EXPRESSED APPREHENSION THAT THERE WILL BE MORE LIBERALIZATION OF THE ECONOMY, MORE DEREGULATION OF STRATEGIC SECTORS, AND MORE PRIVATIZATION VIA PUBLIC-PRIVATE PARTNERSHIP UNDER PRESIDENT AQUINO.  NOTED THAT THE PRESIDENT SPEECH HAD NO MENTION OF AGRARIAN REFORM, THE PLIGHT OF THE WORKERS AND THEIR DEMANDS FOR JUST WAGES AND BETTER WORKING CONDITIONS.  EXPRESSED HOPE THAT THE EFFORTS TO HOLD THE ARROYO REGIME ACCOUNTABLE FOR ITS CRIMES WOULD INCLUDE NOT ONLY CASES OF PLUNDER, GRAFT AND CORRUPTION BUT HUMAN RIGHTS VIOLATIONS AS WELL.  ENUMERATED THE WISHES OF THE PEOPLE THAT SHOULD BE ADDRESSED BY THE AQUINO ADMINISTRATION, AND ASSURED THEM THAT THEY WILL PURSUE THESE WISHES IN ORDER TO SERVE THEM BETTER.
rows.status: Consigned to the Archives on 2010-08-10
rows.remarks: Interpellation by Reps. Suarez, Antonino, Marcoleta. Manifestations of Rep. Gonzales (N.), Marcoleta, Antonino, Magsaysay and Bello.  Referred to the Committee on Rules.

rows.author: G057
rows.title_full: SILENCING THE GUNS:  PURSUING WITH URGENCY PEACE AND DEVELOPMENT IN SOUTHERN PHILIPPINES
rows.title_short: Peace Democracy In Mindanao
rows.abstract: EXPRESSED HIS BELIEF THAT THE GROWTH OF PHIL. DEMOCRACY CENTERS ON THE REALIZATION OF PEACE AND DEV'T ESP. IN MINDANAO.  SAID THAT THIS WOULD ONLY BE REALIZED IF THE GOV'T AND THE BANGSAMORO REBELS WILL PURSUE THE PEACE PROCESS FOR THE CAUSE OF PEACE AND DEV'T IN SOUTHERN PHILS.  CLAIMED THAT THE DEMAND FOR SELF-DETERMINATION OF THE BANSAMORO PEOPLE HAD AFFECTED THE COUNTRY'S NAT'L SECURITY, TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY, POLITICAL STABILITY AND ECONOMIC DEV'T.  MADE THE FF. RECOMMENDATIONS:  PARTICIPATION OF CONGRESS IN EFFECTING THE PEACE PROCESS; REACTIVATION OF THE AMNESTY PROGRAM AND THE CREATION OF A NATIONAL PEACE AND RECONCILIATION COMMISSION; REPRESENTATION OF MEMBERS FROM THE THREE CO-EQUAL BRANCH OF GOVERNMENT IN THE GRP PANEL; AND SUBSTANTIAL BUDGETARY ALLOCATION TO FAST-TRACK ALL DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMS OF THE BANGSAMORO PEOPLE.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SAFETY since 2010-08-10
rows.remarks: Interpellations by Reps. Jaafar and Balindong.  Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.author: F093
rows.title_full: RELEASE OF JUDELYN OLIVEROS FOR HUMANITARIAN REASONS
rows.title_short: Newborn Baby In The Detention Cell
rows.abstract: TALKED ABOUT THE CASE OF MS. JUDILYN OLIVEROS, A COMMUNITYT HEALTH WORKER WHO WAS ILLEGALLY ARRESTED WITH 43 OTHER HEALTH PROFESSIONALS AND VOLUNTEER HEALTH WORKERS.  DISCLOSED THAT SHE WAS 3 MONTHS PREGNANT AT THE TIME OF THE ARREST AND GAVE BIRTH ON JULY 22, 2010.  LAMENTED THAT MS. OLIVEROS WILL NOT BE ABLE TO CONTINUE BREASFEEDING HER CHILD BECAUSE SHE WILL BE BROUGHT BACK TO THE DETERNTION CELL.  STATED THAT HUMAN RIGHTS VIOLATIONS WERE COMMITTED NOT ONLY ON HER BUT ALSO ON HER CHILD AS DETENTION CELLS LACK ADEQUATE FACILITIES NEEDED FOR A HEALTHY AND COMFORTABLE ENVIRONMENT.  CALLED ON THE MEMBERS TO TAKE A STAND AND RECOMMEND THE RELEASE OF MS OLIVERSOS AND HER CHILD AND ALL THE OTHERS, FOR HUMANITARIAN REASONS.  APPEALED TO MEMBERS TO CONTINUE TO SUPPORT THE GABRIELA WOMEN'S PARTY WITH THEIR ADVOCACY.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HUMAN RIGHTS since 2010-08-10
rows.remarks: Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.author: G079
rows.title_full: ONE HUNDRED (100) PERCENT INCREASE IN ELECTRICTY RATES IN MINDANAO
rows.title_short: Electricity Rate In Mindanao
rows.abstract: SPOKE ON THE TREMENDOUS INCREASE OF ELECTRICITY RATES IN MINDANAO.  POINTED OUT THAT IT BEGAN WHEN THE NAT'L GRID CORP. OF THE PHIL. ENTERED INTO AN ANCILLARY SERVICES PROCUREMENT AGREEMENT WITH THERMA MARINE INC. ON THE USE OF POWER BARGES THAT WOULD PROVIDE ADDITIONAL POWER SUPPLY TO THE MINDANAO GRID.  SAID THAT THE NGCP OBTAINED AUTHORITY FOR THE NEW POWER RATES WHEN THE ENERGY REGULATORY COMMISSION GRANTED THE PROVISIONAL AUTHORITY.  CITED THE REASONS WHY THE ERC SHOULD NOT HAVE GRANTED SUCH AUTHORITY.  CALLED ON THE GOVERNMENT TO:  INVESTIGATE SUCH AN INCREASE; TO LET THE NPC AND PSALM EXPLAIN WHY THEY SOLD THE TWO BARGES; TO HAVE THE ERC SUSPEND THE COLLECTION OF THE ILLEGALLY INCREASED RATES AND MAKE THEM EXPLAIN THE GRANTING OF PROV'L AUTHORITY; TO PUT ON HOLD THE PRIVATIZATION OF THE AGUS AND PULANGI HYDRO PLANTS; AND TO REVIEW THE PROVISIONS OF THE EPIRA ON THE SALE OF POWER BADGES.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ENERGY since 2010-08-10
rows.remarks: Interpellations by Reps. Benaldo and Casino.  Referred to the appropriate committee.  Considered as substituted by H.R. No. 823 - URGING PSALM CORP. TO DEFER THE SALE AND PRIVATIZATION OF THE AGUS AND PULANGUI HYDROELECTRIC PLANT COMPLEXES IN MINDANAO

rows.author: F104
rows.title_short: Unparliamentary Remarks.  Referred To The Appropriate Committee.
rows.abstract: REFERRED SPECIFICALLY TO THE POST MORTEM ASSESSMENT ON THE PREVIOUS ADMINISTRATION.  STATED THAT IT WOULD BE A GREAT DISSERVICE TO THE PEOPLE IF THE RECORDS WILL SHOW THAT THE UNPLEASANT AND UGLY REALITIES OF THE PAST GOV'T HAD BEEN DELETED IN THE GUISE OF UPHOLDING DECENCY AND DECORUM.  TOOK TO TASK THE HOUSE LEADERSHIP THAT WAS SUPPOSED TO HAVE BEEN AFFILIATED WITH THE NEW GOV'T, FOR ALLOWING THE DELETION IN THE RECORDS OF REFERENCE TO CORRUPTION AND HUMAN RIGHTS VIOLATIONS BY THE PAST ADMINISTRATION CONTAINED IN THE SPEECHES OF REPS. BELLO AND CASINO.  OPINED THAT THE DECISION TO STRIKE OFF FROM THE RECORDS PART OF THE SPEECHES HAD SET A BAD PRECEDENT AND THAT SAID SPEECHES WERE MERELY SENTIMENTS OF THE THOSE WHO BELIEVE THAT THE PREVIOUS GOV'T WAS GUILTY OF CRIMES AGAINST THE PEOPLE.  APPEALED TO THE HOUSE LEADERSHIP NOT TO CENSOR SPEECHES DELIVERD ON THE FLOOR AND NOT TO PURIFY AND CLEANSE THE RECORD IN THE NAME OF DECORUM.
rows.status: Pending First Reading (Filed last 2010-08-04)
rows.remarks: Manifestations of Reps. Escudero, Villarosa, Farinas and remarks by Rep. Bello.  Referred to the appropriate commitee.

rows.author: F079
rows.title_short: Decorum And Mutual Respect Among House Members
rows.abstract: EXPRESSED SURPRISE THAT ON THE FIRST DAYS OF THE 15TH CONGRESS, SOME MEMBERS FROM THE DEFENDERS OF HUMAN RIGHTS GAVE A VERY BAD EXAMPLE BY USING THE PRIVILEGE SPEECH AS A DISGUISE TO UTTER UNPARLIAMENTARY AND INSULTING REMARKS WHICH BROUGHT DAMAGE TO THE INTEGRITY OF THE HOUSE AS  A WHOLE.  STATED THAT HE ROSE TO PUT THE MATTER IN ITS PROPER PERSPECTIVE AS THE INSULTING REMARKS WERE UTTERED AGAINST HIS MOTHER, FORMER PRES. GLORIA MACAPAGAL-ARROYO, NOW A HOUSE MEMBER.  HE POINTED OUT HER IMPORTANT ACCOMPLISHMENTS AND STRESSED THAT THE ALLEGATIONS MADE TO HER WERE WITHOUT PROOF AND BASIS AND AS SUCH, HER MOTHER SHOULD NOT BE SUBJECTED TO INSULTS BY HER CO-MEMBERS IN THE HOUSE.
rows.status: Pending First Reading (Filed last 2010-08-09)
rows.remarks: Manifestations by Reps. Gonzales(A.), Casino, Barzaga, Kho, Ejercito and Pacquiao.  Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.author: G057
rows.title_full: CALLED FOR AN INVESTIGATION OF THE RECENT ZAMBOANGA INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT BOMBING
rows.title_short: Bombing Incident In Zamboanga City Airport
rows.abstract: Condemned the bombing incident in Zamboanga International Airport (ZIA) on Thursday, August 5, 2010, which killed and wounded several people, including Gov. Abdulsakur Tan.  Sought for an immediate investigation to determine and punish the real culprits of the crime and thus give justice to the fatalities.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SAFETY since 2010-08-24
rows.remarks: Interpellations by Reps. Fabian.  Referred to the appropriate committe.

rows.author: F019
rows.title_full: CALLED FOR IMPROVEMENTS OF THE ZAMBOANGA INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT
rows.title_short: Bombing In Zamboanga International Airport
rows.abstract: Rosed to condemn in the strongest possible terms, the bombing in the Zamboanga City International Airport on August 5, 2010.  Brought to the forefront of national attention, the dire and urgent need to address the serious concerns of the airport facilities in Zamboanga City.  Described the sorry state of the ZIA and enumerated its various needs.  Reiterated the clamor for the transfer of the existing airport somewhere in the east coast of the City for expansion.  Underscored the urgency of the problem considering that this will also add to the development not only of Region IX but the ARMM and the other areas of Mindanao as well.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2010-08-24
rows.remarks: Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.author: F115
rows.title_short: Rights, Benefits And Privileges Of Senior Citizens
rows.abstract: APPEALED THAT HB06910 BE PASSED ESTABLISHING GENERAL GERIATRIC HOSPITALS IN THE COUNTRY SINCE THIS WOULD BE A STEP TO PROVIDING HEALTH ASSISTANCE TO SENIOR CITIZENS.  POINTED OUT THAT IT IS ABOUT TIME THAT SENIOR CITIZENS BE GENEROUSLY PROVIDED WITH CARE THAT WILL ASSIST THEM IN THESE DIFFICULT ECONOMIC CONDITIONS.
rows.status: Pending First Reading (Filed last 2010-08-09)
rows.remarks: Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.title_full: COMPREHENSIVE LAND USE POLICY ON LANDS FOR SOCIALIZED HOUSING AND RESETTLEMENT AREAS
rows.title_short: Comprehensive Land Use Plan
rows.abstract: TALKED ABOUT THE NATIONAL LAND USE POLICY.  GAVE ASSURANCE THAT THE IMPORTANT CONCERN FOR A NATIONAL LAND USE POLICY WOULD BE ADDRESSED AS AN END RESULT TO NATIONAL DEVELOPMENT.  STATED THAT HE WOULD BE SUBMITTING TO THE PRESIDENT AN EXECUTIVE SUMMARY AND IMPLEMENTATION OF THE COMPREHENSIVE LAND USE PLANT (CLUP)TOGETHER WITH A COPY OF HR0144 WHICH HE FILED IN THE HOUSE.  CITED PORTIONS OF PERTINENT LAWS AS HE STRESSED THE CONSEQUENCES OR REPERCUSSIONS OF THE ABSENCE AND NONUPDATING OF COMPREHENSIVE LAND USE PLANS AMONG LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS (LGUs).
rows.status: Committee Report filed on 2010-10-13
rows.remarks: Interpellations by Reps. Bagatsing, Castelo, Biazon and Gonzales (A).  Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.author: F123
rows.title_full: UNFAIR LABOR PRACTICES PHIL. AIRLINES (PAL)
rows.title_short: Philippine Airlines' Unfair Labor Practices
rows.abstract: SPOKE ON THE REASON WHY THE PHIL. AIRLINES (PAL)WAS ONCE AGAIN IN A MESS.  EXPRESSED BELIEF THAT THE PRESENT DIFFICULTIES IN THE AIRLINE ARE CAUSED BY PAL MANAGEMENT'S UNFAIR LABOR PRACTICES - USING THE VEL OF CORPORATE SUSTAINABILITY AND COMPETITIVENESS.  APPEALED TO THE PAL MANAGEMENT TO STOP BEING UNJUST TO THE WORKERS, TO TAKE CARE OF THEM, TO RESPECT THEIR SECURITY OF TENURE AND TO FOLLOW THE LAW.  URGED THOSE ENGAGED IN BUSINESS NOT TO VIOLATE CORE LABOR STANDARDS, OR THE TUCP WILL RUN AFTER THEM TO ATTAIN EQUITY, JUSTICE AND FAIRNESS.
rows.status: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2011-10-18
rows.remarks: Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.author: E047
rows.title_full: HACIENDA LUISITA COMPROMISE AGREEMENT
rows.title_short: Compromise Agreement Between Hacienda Luisita Inc. And The Farm Workers
rows.abstract: SAID THAT FARMERS OF HACIENDA LUISITA WERE SURPRISED BY AN ILLEGAL COMPROMISE AGREEMENT SIGNED BY THE OFFICIALS OF HLI AND ALLEGEDLY BY THE LEADERS OF THE LEGITIMATE FARMERS THERIN WHO HAD MISREPRESENTED THEIR INTEREST.  OPINED THAT IT WOULD SEEM THAT THE INTENT OF THE ILLEGAL COMPROMISE AGREEMENT IS TO PREEMPT THE SUPREME COURT WHICH HAD ALREADY SET A DATE FOR THE ORAL ARGUMENTS REGARDING THE HLI. EXPLAINED THAT THE SAID AGREEMENT COVERED ONLY 33% OF THE COMPANY'S TOTAL ASSETS, DID NOT INVOLVE THE PARC, AND WAS MERELY A DECEITFUL, ANTI-FARMER, AND PROLANDLORD/AGRIBUSINESS PLOY OF THE COJUANCO-AQUINO FAMILY FOR LAND CONVERSION.  STRESSED THAT HLI CASE WAS THE FARMERS' STRUGGLE FOR AGRARIAN REFORM AND SOCIAL JUSTICE AND NOT MERELY AN \"INTRA-CORPORATE DISPUTE\". ASKED THE HOUSE TO INVESTIGATE WHAT WAS HAPPENING IN HACIENDA LUISITA AND TO MONITOR THE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE CARPER AND MASSIVE LAND GRABBING IN THE COUNTRYSIDE.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRARIAN REFORM since 2010-08-24
rows.remarks: Interpellations by Reps. Casino.  Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.author: C111
rows.title_short: T E S D A's True State
rows.abstract: REQUESTED THAT HIS SPEECH RE: TESDA'S TRUE STATE BE INSERTED INTO THE RECORD OF THE HOUSE.  THIS IS IN RESPONSE TO THE ALLEGED TESDA IRREGULARITIES AS WELL AS OTHER CIRCUMSTANCES APPEARING IN MEDIA ON AUGUST 9, 2010.  MENTIONED ABOUT TESDA'S FUNDING THAT NEVER TRANSPIRED; THE TEKBOK SCHOLARSHIP PROGRAMS; THE LADDERIZED EDUCATION PROGRAMS (LEP) UNDER THE ARROYO ADMINISTRATION; AND THE UNWARRANTED CRITICISMS IN SPITE OF TESDA'S ACCOMPLISHMENTS.
rows.status: Pending First Reading (Filed last 2010-08-09)
rows.remarks: Inserted into the Records.

rows.author: G009
rows.title_short: Agrarian Reform
rows.abstract: CITED THE CASE OF THE SUMILAO FARMERS AS WELL AS THAT OF THE HACIENDA LUISITA INC., AND THE PASSAGE OF RA9700 OR THE CARPER LAW DURING THE INCUMBENCY OF FORMER PRES. GLORIA MACAPAGAL-ARROYO. POINTED OUT THAT HACIENDA LUISITA CASE WILL SEND A STRONG POLITICL SIGNAL FOR THE SUCCESSFUL IMPLEMENTATION OF AGRARIAN REFORM; AND ASIDE FROM THE STOCK DISTRIBUTION SCHEME, THE FARMERS HAD OTHER OPTIONS, SUCH AS COLLECTIVE LAND OPERATION AND MANAGEMENT, IF THE HACIENDA WAS DISTRIBUTED TO THEM IN SMALL INDIVIDUAL PARCELS. URGED THE HOUSE NOT TO EXTINGUISH THE PEASANT'S HOPE FOR LAND OWNERSHIP BY EXERCISING ITS MANDATE TO ENSURE AN ADEQUATE LAND DISTRIBUTION BUDGET, TO EXERCISE ITS OVERSIGHT FUNCTIONS IN THE IMPLEMENTATION OF LAND LAWS, AND TO ENACT COMPONENT LEGISLATION SUCH AS THE NATIONAL LAND USE ACT.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRARIAN REFORM since 2010-08-24
rows.remarks: Interpellations by Reps. Arroyo (I) and Lagman.  Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.author: G092
rows.title_full: INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
rows.title_short: Network Readiness Of The Philippines.
rows.abstract: DESCRIBED THE STATE OF INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY (ICT) IN THE PHILS. AND HOW IT COULD BE IMPROVED SUCH AS CREATING A DEPT. OF INFORMATION & COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY (DICT). EMPHASIZED GEARING THE EDUCATIONAL SECTOR TO SERVE THE NEEDS OF THIS NEW ECONOMY; ICT IS A PREREQUISITE TO GOOD GOVERNANCE MAKING THE ENVIRONMENT CONDUCIVE FOR THE ICT INDUSTRY; THE ICT IS A CHANNEL FOR FREE AND EMPOWERED MEDIA; THE ICT IS A CATALYST FOR POVERTY ALLEVIATION AS TECHNOLOGY CAN BE CULTIVATED, NURTURED IN ONE'S CULTURE AND ECONOMY AND CAN BECOME THE IMPETUS OF WEALTH SHARING AMONG THE PEOPLE. TINGA ALSO FOCUSED ON SHORT MESSAGE SERVICE (SMS) TEXTING AND SUGGESTED THAT TELEPHONE COMPANIES PROVIDE FREE INTERNET ACCESS TO LEARNING INSTITUTIONS. RECOMMENDED THAT PRIVATE SCHOOLS BE GIVEN LOWER TAX RATE INCENTIVES IN RETURN FOR SETTING ASIDE 20% OF THEIR ENROLMENT TO DESERVING STUDENTS. REFERRED ANEW TO THE WORLD ECONOMIC FORUM REPORT, AND CONCLUDED THAT THE COUNTRY RATES HIGH INSOFAR AS CREATIVE AND HIGH TECHNOLOGY EXPORTS ARE CONCERNED. CONCLUDED THAT TECHNOLOGY IS REALLY ABOUT PEOPLE, AND STRESSED THEIR TASK OF TRANSFORMING THE COUNTRY INTO A GLOBALLY COMPETITIVE AND SELF-RELIANT ECONOMY.
rows.status: Scheduled for first meeting/hearing on 2011-05-16
rows.remarks: Interpellations by Reps. Paez, Golez (R.), Rodriguez (R), Dimaporo (F), Herrera-Dy and Palmones.  Referred to the appropriate committee.

committee_action.meethigh: The Committee instructed the Commission on Information and Communications Technology, Department of National Defense, Department of Science and Technology, National Telecommunications Commission, National Computer Center, Departments of Education, Environment and Natural Resources and Justice to meet and clarify the direction of the national broadband project in the country and submit a report to the Committee within thirty (30) days.

rows.author: F100
rows.title_full: HUMAN RIGHTS VIOLATIONS
rows.title_short: Human Rights
rows.abstract: CITED THE RISING NUMBER OF DESAPARECIDOS AND VICTIMS OF EXTRAJUDICAIL KILLING. BROUGHT THE PLIGHT OF THE SO-CALLED \"MORONG 43\" TO HIS COLLEAGUES' ATTENTION, EMPHASIZING THAT THOSE WHO WERE ILLEGALLY ARRESTED ON TRUMPED-UP CHARGES, TORTURED, JAILED, AND DENIED COUNSEL AND FAMILY SHOULD BE IMMEDIATELY RELEASED. STRESSED THAT PRES. AQUINO'S HUMAN RIGHTS AGENDA IS A VERY IMPORTANT COMPONENT OF CHANGE AS BASIS IN DECIDING TO WALK THROUGH THE RIGHT PATH. ALSO STRESSED THAT IT SHOULD START WITH THE RELEASE OF POLITICAL PRISONERS, ESP. THE \"MORONG 43\", DISMISSAL OF THE HARASSMENT CASES OF HUMAN RIGHTS ADVOCATES, AND ABANDONMENT OF OPLAN BANTAY LAYA AND PEACE TALKS WITH THE NDF AND THE MILF.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HUMAN RIGHTS since 2010-08-24
rows.remarks: Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.title_full: MEDIA RESPONSIBLITY
rows.title_short: Mauling Incident In Camiguin Involving Two Fake Mediamen And Gov. Jj. Romualdo And His Bodyguards.
rows.abstract: STATED THAT HE WOULD LIKE TO PUT SOME PERSPECTIVE IN THE INCREASING INTEREST OF MEDIA IN HIS DISTRICT SINCE THE ALLEGED PUBLICIZED INCIDENT INVOLVING FAKE MEDIA MEN IN CATARMAN, CAMIGUIN ON MAY 9, 2010. SAID THAT HERBERT HUGO F. DUMAGUING, WHO CLAIMED TO BE HIRED BY AN AREA SUPERVISOR OF TV 13 OF CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY, DEPICTED A VERY GORY DETAIL OF THE INCIDENT TO MALIGN GOV. JJ ROMUALDO'S NAME, REPUTATION AND INTEGRITY. HE ADDED THAT MR. DUMAGUING AND HIS COHORTS LURED THEIR VICTIMS INTO BELIEVING THAT THEY WERE JOURNALISTS WHEN IN TRUTH, THEY WERE CON MEN WHO EXTORT MONEY FROM THEIR VICTIMS. EXPRESSED HOPE THAT MEDIA SHOULD NOT PERMIT ITSELF TO BE USED TO ADVANCE THE WHIMS AND CAPRICES OF CERTAIN GROUPS OR INDIVIDUALS AS WHAT WAS DONE TO GOV. ROMUALDO. OPINED THAT THE MEDIA ATTACKS AGAINST HIM WERE IN RESPONSE TO HIS STAND ON THE FREEDOM OF INFORMATION BILL, STRESSED THAT THE FREEDOM IS PROPORTIONATE TO RESTRAINT AND THAT IT SHOULD BE CREDIBLE.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC INFORMATION since 2010-08-24
rows.remarks: Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.author: F103
rows.title_full: RICE CRISIS
rows.title_short: N F A's Importation Of Rice
rows.abstract: EXPRESSED BUTIL PARTY-LIST'S SUPPORT FOR THE GOVERNMENT'S POLICY TO END RICE IMPORTAION WHICH WORKS AGAINST THE INTEREST OF SMALL FARMERS, FOOD SECURITY AND RICE SELF-SUFFICIENCY. STRESSED THAT SUCH IMPORTATION DURING HARVEST SEASON RESULTED IN LOSSES AMONG LOCAL FARMERS. DESCRIBED AMONG OTHERS THE NEGATIVE RAMIFICATIONS OF THE PERCEIVED OVERSUPPLY OF RICE IN THE COUNTRY, WHICH INCLUDED AMONG OTHERS, REDUCED GOVERNMENT REVENUE FROM THE TARIFF-FREE NFA RICE IMPORTS AND LOSSES AS A RESULT OF BUYING IMPORTED RICE AT HIGH COSTS AND SELLING IT LOCALLY AT LOW PRICES. PROPOSED SOME COURSES OF ACTION THAT THE GOVERNMENT AND THE NFA SHOULD DO TO ADDRESS THE PERENNIAL RICE CRISIS. SAID THAT THE COUNTRY'S RICE PRODUCTIVITY WILL IMPROVE ONLY IF THE FILIPINO FARMERS WOULD GET ENOUGH GOVERNMENT ASSISTANCE IN TERMS OF POLICIES, PROGRAMS, CREDIT, TECHNICAL AND EXTENSION SERVICES AND BUDGETARY SUPPORT.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE AND FOOD since 2010-08-24
rows.remarks: Interpellation by Reps. Fua, Ping-ay, Golez and Bello. Remarks of Rep. Escudero. Referral to the appropriate committee.

rows.author: G106
rows.title_short: National Language
rows.abstract: REMINDED HER COLLEAGUES AND THEIR CONSTITUENTS THAT THE MONTH OF AUGUST IS THE ONLY MONTH THAT REMINDS THEM THAT AS A PEOPLE, THEY BELONG TO A NATION THAT IS, BY NATURE, DIVERSE IN LANGUAGESAND IN SO MANY OTHER BEAUTIFUL WAYS. . ENUMERATED THE 10 MAJORITY LANGUAGES BEING USED IN THE PHILIPPINES AND THE MOST SPOKEN LANGUAGES WITH THE POPULATION AND PERCENTAGE OF SPEAKERS. RECOMMENDED. RECOMMENDED THAT CONGRESS CREATE A COMMITTEE ON LANGUAGES AND CULTURAL PRSERVATION \"THAT WILL STUDY, INVESTIGATE, AND ENACT LEGISLATIVE MEASURES PERTINENT TO ALL THE ISSUES AND CONCERNS RE: NATIONAL AND REGIONAL LANGUAGES OF THE PHILIPPINES.
rows.status: Pending First Reading (Filed last 2010-08-11)
rows.remarks: Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.author: G081
rows.title_full: ZAMBOANGA BOMBING INCIDENT
rows.title_short: Police Officers' Statement That The Bombing Incident In Zamboanga Airport Was Politically Motivated
rows.abstract: CONDEMNED THE BOMBING OF THE ZAMBOANGA CITY INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT LAST AUGUST 6, 2010. REVEALED THAT SOME POLICE OFFICERS IN THE REGION HAVE PRESENTED INNUENDOS, IMPLICATED POLITICAL PERSONALITIES AND ADVERSARIES OPPOSED TO GOV. ABDULSAKUR TAN WITHOUTY ANY PHYSICAL EVIDENCE AND HAVE CONCLUDED THAT THE BOMBING INCIDENT WAS NOT AN ACT OF TERROR BUT POLITCALLY MOTIVATED. APPEALED TO THE POLICE AUTHORITIES TO BE CIRCUMSPECT IN THEIR PRONOUNCEMENTS AND FAST TRACK THE INVESTIGATION OF THE BOMBING INCIDENT AND INDICT THE TRUE CULPRITS AND PERPETRATORS.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SAFETY since 2010-08-25

rows.author: G039
rows.title_full: CALLED FOR GOOD GOVERNANCE
rows.title_short: Alleged Corruption Under The Arroyo Administration
rows.abstract: RECALLED HOW PRES. BENIGNO C. AQUINO III IN HIS SONA DESCRIBED SEVERAL ANOMALIES OF THE PREVIOUS ADMINISTRATION AND HOW HIS TWO COLLEAGUES SPOKE OF ITS CORRUPTION WHILE THE MEMBERS CLOSE TO THE FORMER PRESIDENT TRIUMPHANTLY MOVED TO STRIKE OFF FROM THE RECORDS THE ESSENCE OF THEIR SPEECHES BECAUSE OF UNPARLIAMENTARY LANGUAGE. EXPRESSED APPREHENSION THAT... THE ESSENCE OF THE SPEECH IS CURTAILED AND THE PAST ADMIN. IS PROTECTED. SAID THAT HE WAS NOT AFRAID TO POINT OUT THE ANOMALIES COMMITTED AND CITED AND EXPLAINED WHAT HE SAID WERE ITS WORST QUALITIES. CLAIMED THAT HIS FATHER HAD VINDICATED HIMSELF WHEN ALMOST 10 MILLION FILIPINOS HAD VOTED FOR HIM. CHALLENGED FORMER PRES. MACAPAGAL-ARROYO TO ANSWER THE ALLEGATIONS AGAINST HER.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOOD GOVERNMENT AND PUBLIC ACCOUNTABILITY since 2010-08-25
rows.remarks: Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.author: G093
rows.title_full: GSIS BENEFITS OF TEACHERS
rows.title_short: Irregularities / Discrepancies In The Gsis Benefits Of Teachers And Employees
rows.abstract: TOOK TO TASK FORMER GSIS CHAIRPERSON WINSTON F. GARCIA FOR HIS FAILED REFORM AGENDA WHICH HAD SOUGHT TO INSTITUTE REFORMS FOR PROMPT AND EFFICIENT DELIVERY OF SERVICES TO THE GSIS. CLAIMED THAT THE FAILURE IN THE COMPUTERIZATION OF THE GSIS' SERVICES HAD RESULTED IN THE FAILURE OF POSTING P6 BILLION WORTH OF REMITTANCES OF INDIVIDUAL MEMBERS SINCE 1997. CITED THAT THE AMOUNT OF UNPOSTED REMITTANCES HAD ALREADY AMOUNTED TO P50.461 BILLION WHICH HAD RESULTED TO ARBITRARY AND UNJUSTIFIED DEDUCTIONS AND THAT ITS CLIP OR THE AUTOMATIC DEDUCTION OF ARREARS HAD VIOLATED THE RIGHTS OF THE MEMBERS TO DUE PROCESS AND SEC. 41-W OF THE GSIS ACT OF 1997. CALLED ON HIS COLLEAGUES TO DO THEIR DUTY TO HELP PROTECT GSIS MEMBERS.
rows.status: Scheduled for first meeting/hearing on 2010-12-14
rows.remarks: Referred to the appropriate committee.
